traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), families 48 Caprifoliaceae, 306 Adoxaceae, 312 Valerianaceae and 313 Dipsacaceae, which make APG's Dipsacales (Caprifoliaceae in the wide sense, and Viburnaceae): leaves opposite, rarely whorled; stipules absent or very small; the calyx on an inferior ovary.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Dipsacales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): leaves opposite, bases often joined; opposite pairs cross (decussate).

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Dipsacales page (read 2026-10-16): leaves mostly simple; Sambucus compound, some Dipsacoideae and Valerianoideae pinnate.

traits.inflorescence.note: APweb, Dipsacales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): branches cymose; Viburnaceae flat-topped many-flowered cymes; Dipsacoideae heads.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Dipsacales page (read 2026-10-16): ovary inferior with persistent calyx; no free hypanthium described.

traits.carpels.note: APweb, Dipsacales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): carpels three. Replaces the campanulid inherited 2; families state their own.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Dipsacales page (read 2026-10-16): no order statement; flowers perfect in most; dioecy reported (uncertain) in some Valerianoideae and Viburnum.
